other_failure_modes.name: unhandled_special_missing_values
other_failure_modes.description: The agent fails to identify and handle dataset-specific missing value indicators (such as -200 in the Air Quality dataset). Treating these placeholders as valid numeric values introduces extreme outliers that severely corrupt model training and evaluation.

summary: The agent correctly formulated the time-series regression problem, engineered valid temporal features, and safely used TimeSeriesSplit for validation. However, it critically failed to recognize that the Air Quality dataset uses '-200' as a placeholder for missing values, treating them as valid numeric inputs and targets, which completely invalidates the model.
